title: RAW Galen synonym conservation: local form assimilation among complete meaning-equivalent paragraph rewritings
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. Keep all 59 Galen guesses and exactly six explicit synonym classes. Construct complete counterfactual rewritings with identical semantic positions and exact per-paragraph form multisets. A new local form-assimilation hypothesis predicts smaller whole-word edit distance between immediate written neighbours than the mean of the layout-conditioned semantic orbit. This is a mechanism diagnostic, not a new gloss or a capacity repair; no corpus census or score has run.

design.mechanism: Meaning fixes the whole-word synonym class at each slot; a postsemantic writing preference may choose among licensed exact synonyms to increase similarity to immediate written neighbours. The complete source assertion sequence is unchanged.
design.unit: One complete already fitted development paragraph and its finite meaning-preserving, exact-inventory-preserving surface orbit. Whole paragraphs, not isolated favourable tokens, are retained.
design.contrast: Meaning-constant local assimilation versus exchangeable surface placement conditional on the same six classes, exact paragraph form multiset and fixed line-edge/PREV_DY/CURRENT_ENDS_DY strata.
design.prediction: For every development paragraph whose permitted orbit changes the score, observed S=-sum(unit-cost Levenshtein distance of adjacent whole raw groups within each physical line) exceeds the exact conditional orbit mean. This is a predeclared qualitative diagnostic requirement, not an assertion that all individual choices minimize distance or that one negative sample proves a stochastic law false.
design.ceiling: The requirement tests only this added writing preference together with the guessed synonym classes. The interpretation of an observed positive bias cannot select the literal Galen meanings: opaque classes or another lexicon with the same equality partition give the same result.

complete_synonym_matrix.basis: r explicitly has the exact copular denotation of qoky.
okedy explicitly has the same food-kind L denotation as qokain.
san explicitly has the same food-kind-to-nourishment-profile denotation as saiiin.
All four explicitly share propositional negation before argument application. The propositions negated may differ; the rule tracks lexical-denotation recurrence, not repeated propositions.
Both explicitly denote the same food-kind T.

matrix_limits: All 59 old values, types and full denotations remain verbatim in the bound parents. The other 45 forms are singleton classes.
PEDANTS_SHAM_LEARNING and PEDANTS are not synonyms merely because their reference P overlaps. No seventh family is added.

NOT variants keep the same operator, not the same negated proposition; source subjects and scopes stay position-bound. NOURISHMENT variants keep the same function, not an automatically identical food owner.

Synonymy alone does not establish freely substitutable surface syntax. Extensional slot substitution while keeping the entire parent derivation is an additional declared condition of these counterfactuals, not a new completed parser.

fixed_diagnostic_contract.freeze: No score, score range, orbit size or new corpus count was computed while producing this card. The two deterministic demonstrations are not selected by similarity.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.development_scope: Exactly the full ZL3b f76v.37–41 and f80v.19–22 paragraphs in the two parent files, 55 and 33 groups. Both are historically exposed and fitted. Keep every raw group and every source flag. No line, clause, name or negative example is removed.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.transcription_status: The complete ZL hypotheses are transcription-conditional: several lines are anchor_eligible=false and f80v has raw [o:a]por and olpo{ikh}y. The diagnostic measures exactly these supplied raw strings including notation characters; it is not a claim about resolved glyph distance. IT full records and their unbound fusion/split/sar/tor/yrchey differences remain in parent files; no IT semantic alias is manufactured. RF has no complete corresponding record.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.metric: Unit insertion/deletion/substitution cost 1 over literal ASCII characters in each unchanged raw complete group. No normalization, case folding, glyph interpretation, BPE, transposition operation, length normalization, substring weighting or alternative distance. Compute -sum(distance) over ALL consecutive pairs within each physical line, never across a line break. Constant edges remain in the total and naturally cancel.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.semantic_orbit: Use exactly the six listed families and singleton remaining values. Independently assign each paragraph-family-stratum exact multiset to its existing positions, counting each distinct whole-form sequence once. Strata are physical-line edge class SINGLE/FIRST/LAST/INTERIOR, PREV_DY from previous same-line raw group, and CURRENT_ENDS_DY. The latter preserves the entire previous-dy vector under simultaneous permutations. Never exchange across paragraphs or classes.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.enumeration: Enumerate the whole finite Cartesian product of distinct multiset permutations, including the observed world. Abort before scoring if predicted orbit cardinality exceeds 1000000 for either paragraph; do not sample or change conditioning after that. No rank/length term, fitted beta, strength parameter, probabilistic tilt or family weighting is introduced.
fixed_diagnostic_contract.reported_outputs: For each complete paragraph retain observed score, full exact score histogram, orbit mean, range, observed tie-inclusive upper rank, full class contributions and the concrete closest and farthest complete counterfactuals. The rank is descriptive, not a confirmatory p-value. Also retain the observed score of the unrestricted semantic demonstration separately; it never enters the controlled orbit.

outcomes.NO_MOBILE_SCORE: The permitted orbit has one score, even if words can permute. No decision about assimilation; retain the full paragraph.
outcomes.DIRECTIONAL_COMPATIBILITY: Every score-mobile paragraph has observed score above its exact orbit mean. Retain the extra mechanism as a development-compatible candidate only; no manuscript or semantic PASS.
outcomes.DIRECTIONAL_NONCONFIRMATION: Any score-mobile complete paragraph has observed score at or below its orbit mean. This fails the declared qualitative development requirement of the added assimilation rule; it does not refute the old meanings or all probabilistic writers.
outcomes.UNFINISHED_OR_INVALID: Incomplete semantic conservation, unresolved encoding mismatch, enumeration limit, or an altered parent hash stops this recipe without reassigning values.

nondevelopment_separation.possible_scope: If separately selected after review, use only the already owned GDT928 complete paragraph packet, physical leaves other than the full leaves76 and80, excluding f84/f84r/f116v before content. ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b stay separate. No reserve, page, image or source admission.
nondevelopment_separation.unchanged_guardrails: A future manuscript comparison must retain IDEA509 whole-literal paragraph eligibility, layout/dy strata and complete denominator. Its existing 20-mobile-block/40-position/5-leaf and three-powered-family gates are NOT reduced here. The present development diagnostic uses no manuscript-support gate and cannot substitute for these.
nondevelopment_separation.known_stop: GDT1031 already reports ZL0 mobile blocks, IT16 blocks/34 positions/12 leaves with only2 powered families, RF no paragraph data. Those observations remain a capacity stop for an unchanged held comparison. This card authorizes no rerun, no feature/gate repair and no claim that a different distance repairs capacity.
nondevelopment_separation.selection_prerequisite: Before any nondevelopment score, an independent review must identify a genuinely different defensible test unit with a complete, predeclared decision and demonstrate that it does not merely lower the known1031 gates. Otherwise this proposal remains only the two-paragraph conditional mechanism diagnostic.

predecessor_review.IL008_strongest_adverse_family: ADJACENT_ROOT_TRANSCRIPTION_SHAPE is registry-reported FROZEN_NONCONFIRMATION: seven views did not confirm held, ZL edit similarity p=.340 and RF opposite sign. The linked results/il008_conditional_root_shape_report.md was absent; bounded rg filename searches also found no primary. These are inherited summary limits, not independently audited findings. Primary recovery/review is mandatory before promotion or treating this as a reopened adjacency route.
predecessor_review.difference_from_507_508_509_510: No l-constructor congruence, r/l involution, shorter-later prediction, fixed beta, new negation frame or new meaning. All source assertions are preserved while only same-denotation complete spellings exchange.

named_freedoms: One additional qualitative writing preference: immediate neighbour form assimilation.
One explicitly frozen unit-cost whole-string edit metric and one same-line adjacency window; no metric search.
One extensional semantic-substitution assumption for all six synonym classes, including operator/function synonyms.
Exactly two pre-existing complete development records and two deterministic counterfactual procedures; no record selection by a score.
Inherited full source productions, binding assumptions and unresolved alternate-reader gaps stay unchanged.
No observed target score, no newly assigned meaning, no free exception, no new source, no independent replication.

decision_note.unknown: Whether all the fixed synonymous spellings can vary without changing the full derivation while their observed choices show the specific local-form preference after fixed layout controls.
decision_note.smallest_test: The exact two development orbits above, only after reviewer accepts the semantic-substitution condition. No full-corpus implementation is needed for this diagnostic.
decision_note.stop: At budget or enumeration bound retain partial outputs and stop. No automatic held run, alternative distance, loosened eligibility or third paragraph.
